Orbe helado, Relámpago y Cadena de rayos: Frozen Orb, Lightning and Chain Lightning with Thunder Storm active. Three Tal Rasha pieces, The Oculus, a buff weapon set and a fully equipped Infinity mercenary.
Jabalinas eléctricas, Golpe cargado para: Lightning javelins, Charged Strike for bosses, physical Jab and Valkyrie. Native level 85 equipment, a fully equipped mercenary and a buff weapon set.
Martillos con Concentración, Escudo sagr: Blessed Hammer with Concentration, Holy Shield and teleport mobility. The main equipment reaches the 125% Faster Cast Rate breakpoint using native properties.
Doble Grief, Torbellino y Berserk contra: Dual Grief, Whirlwind and Berserk against physical immunes. Native warcries, Find Item and a mercenary with Decrepify.
Esqueletos, Amplificar daño y Explosión: Skeletons, Amplify Damage and Corpse Explosion. Golem, Revive and stash alternatives for summoning and Fanaticism.
Tornado físico y Huracán de frío, Armadu: Physical Tornado and cold Hurricane, Cyclone Armor, Oak Sage and Grizzly. A Decrepify mercenary supports physical damage.
Centinela de rayos, Centinela mortal, fu: Lightning Sentry, Death Sentry, backup fire damage and Shadow Master. Burst of Speed speeds up trap placement; Fade provides a defensive alternative.
Apocalipsis, Ola de llamas y sus sinergi: Apocalypse, Flame Wave and their native synergies; Demonic Mastery, all summons, Blood Oath and Bind Demon within native skill requirements.

Orbe helado con tres piezas de Tal Rasha: Frozen Orb with three Tal Rasha pieces and native equipment.
Activa la armadura de hielo y usa Teletr: Cast Frozen Armor and use Teleport to position yourself.
Orbe helado es el ataque principal; Camp: Frozen Orb is your main attack; Static Field reduces boss life. Switching weapon sets preserves your equipment.
Activa Armadura de hielo con F4 y Tormen: Cast Frozen Armor with F4 and Thunder Storm with F5. Alternate Frozen Orb (F1) with Chain Lightning (F6) for groups and Lightning (F7) against cold-resistant enemies. Start boss fights with Static Field (F3); use Teleport (F2) to bring your mercenary along and position the Orb. F8 opens a town portal.
F1 contra grupos; F2 cuerpo a cuerpo con: Use F1 for groups and F2 in melee against bosses. Jab (F7) deals physical damage when lightning immunity remains. Summon Valkyrie with F3; teleport with F4.
Deja Concentración(F2) en el botón derec: Keep Concentration (F2) on the right button and Blessed Hammer on the left; Shift-left-click to cast while standing still. Cast Holy Shield (F3). After Teleport (F4), switch back to Concentration. Your mercenary handles magic-immune enemies.
Torbellino(F1) para grupos; Berserk(F2): Use Whirlwind (F1) for groups and Berserk (F2) for magic damage against physical immunes. Leap Attack (F4) provides movement. Cast Shout (F5) before combat and use Find Item (F3) afterward. Your mercenary applies Decrepify. Enigma is available as a mobility alternative.
Levanta esqueletos(F1), magos(F8), golem: Raise skeletons (F1), mages (F8), a golem (F5) and revived monsters (F6). Cast Amplify Damage (F3), then chain Corpse Explosion (F2) after the first kill. Decrepify (F7) controls bosses; Teleport (F4) gathers your army. Use Leoric for summoning and Beast as a Fanaticism alternative.
Invoca Roble(F5), Oso(F6) y apoyo(F7/F8): Summon Oak Sage (F5), Grizzly (F6) and support summons (F7/F8). Cast Hurricane (F2) and Cyclone Armor (F3), and refresh them when they expire. Tornado (F1) deals physical damage; Hurricane deals cold damage. Your mercenary applies Decrepify to support physical damage.
Invoca Maestra de las sombras(F3); Ráfag: Summon Shadow Master (F3). Burst of Speed (F5) speeds up trap placement. Place Lightning Sentries (F1), then add Death Sentry (F2) after the first kill. Fire Blast (F8) provides another damage type. Fade (F6) replaces Burst of Speed when you need more defense.
Invoca Desolladores(F3) y activa Pacto d: Summon Defilers (F3) and cast Blood Oath (F5). Mark the target with F6; Apocalypse (F1) and Flame Wave (F2) deal fire damage. Consume (F7) and Bind Demon (F8) are learned. Choose your bound demon in the game. The alternate grimoires in your stash are native items; one grants Lower Resist.
Empieza en el equipo I. Pulsa W para cam: Start on weapon set I. Press W to switch to set II, cast Battle Command (F9), then Battle Orders (F10), and press W to return to set I. These buffs are temporary. Cast them when entering a game and refresh them when they expire.
Cuatro grandes de habilidades y dieciséi: Four skill grand charms and sixteen Ancient small charms, plus Annihilus, Hellfire Torch and Gheed's Fortune: native charm weight 34, below the limit of 41. Keep them in the active inventory.
Los pequeños aportan 80 a todas las resi: Small charms provide 80 to all resistances; Annihilus and Hellfire Torch add 20, and the three Anya scrolls add 30. Equipment and runes cover the rest of Hell's −120 penalty. Final values are checked when each save is generated.
Todos los objetos nuevos tienen nivel 85: All new items have item level 85, properties from the installed tables and mid-range rolls.
No se añadieron afijos imposibles, corru: No invalid affixes, corruption or hidden upgrades were added.
Hay tres Tokens of Absolution por person: Each character has three Tokens of Absolution for resetting skills and attributes.
Cambiar alternativas puede modificar bon: Switching equipment can change bonuses, speed, blocking and resistances. Requirements are checked against equipped items and active charms.
La verificación binaria y de tablas no e: Binary and table verification is not an in-game engine test. These newly created classes still need their first in-game check.
